Varmora reported a 498% surge in H1 profit driven by premium tile margins.

what_to_watch: Monitor trade receivables and credit sales verification for outstation buyers to prevent fraud.

surat.headline: Severe yarn cost spikes and embroidery strikes squeeze Surat margins despite policy and export upsides.
what_changed: Looms face shutdowns of 15 to 30 days due to yarn prices jumping 45-50% (₹50/kg), impacting up to 75,000 workers ahead of Diwali.
A three-month embroidery labor dispute escalated into agitational phases and the detention of over 80 workers demanding wages and holidays.
Polished diamond exports dropped 7%, accompanied by UK scrutiny over lab-grown diamond advertising.
Textile operational stability was hit by an 8-hour power outage and a commercial market fire in Salabatpura.
stress_signals: Raw material price hikes of 45-50% (₹50/kg) driving early loom closures and scheduled month-long shutdowns [48c63a4e50b6, b567711c9ed4, 1b54f570ed7b].
Three-month unresolved wage/holiday strike paralyzing embroidery units and halting job-work cash flows [8a31a5a2c20c, 442c4ff911f8, 7697e96a190e, e7921383cbb7].
Arrest of a Surat businessman over a ₹10.14 crore textile fraud and report of unpaid diamond polishing wages [2514ad7d6e20, 698c779932f2].
Polished diamond export volumes contracted 7% amidst regulatory alerts in the UK regarding LGD marketing [975918f112f3, b1b313249339].
improvement_signals: GST Council granted Input Tax Credit (ITC) refunds and reduced highway transit inspections for textiles [17f0a015a73c].
New trade avenues emerging via the India-New Zealand FTA and initial cluster diversification into defence technical textiles [8e92d85d894d, 0f163b499572].
ICA-GemLab established its first Indian testing laboratory in Surat for diamonds, gems, and jewellery [26bd1ecd549c].
what_to_watch: Release and details of the upcoming national/state textile policy expected within three months [7cb0d1c51743, a3db8ea1103a].
Account-level EMI servicing and working capital drawdowns among computerized embroidery job-work borrowers facing persistent strikes.
Inventory carrying costs and repayment delays in weaving units shutting down early due to yarn price inflation.
